name: Securities Peg Order Instruction
definition: Instructions specific to pegged orders, which consist in an investor buying large amounts of  the underlying asset of a derivative it holds.

Offset.name: Offset
Offset.definition: Amount (signed) added to the peg for a pegged order.

MoveType.name: Move Type
MoveType.definition: Describes whether peg is static/fixed or floats.

LimitType.name: Limit Type
LimitType.definition: Specifies nature of resulting pegged price.

Scope.name: Scope
Scope.definition: The scope of "related to" price of the peg (for example, local, global etc).

OffsetSign.name: Offset Sign
OffsetSign.definition: Indicates whether the offset should be added to or subtracted from the peg for a pegged order.

RoundDirection.name: Round Direction
RoundDirection.definition: If the calculated peg price is not a valid tick price, specifies how to round the price.
